arxiv-2110-05970.title: Localization and slow-thermalization in a cluster spin model
arxiv-2110-05970.creator: Yoshihito Kuno, Takahiro Orito, Ikuo Ichinose
arxiv-2110-05970.description: Abstract Novel cluster spin model with interactions and disorder is introduced and studied. In specific type of interactions, we find an extensive number of local integrals of motion (LIOMs), which are a modified version of the stabilizers in quantum information, i.e., mutually commuting operators specifying all quantum states in the system.

arxiv-2201-06325.title: A Tree Clock Data Structure for Causal Orderings in Concurrent Executions Conference: 27th ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems; February 28-March 4, 2022; Lausanne, Switzerland 27th ACM International Conference on Architectural Suppor
arxiv-2201-06325.creator: Umang Mathur, Andreas Pavlogiannis, Hnkar Can Tun, Mahesh Viswanathan
arxiv-2201-06325.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Umang Mathur, Andreas Pavlogiannis, Hnkar Can Tun, Mahesh Viswanathan. Dynamic techniques are a scalable and effective way to analyze concurrent programs. Instead of analyzing all behaviors of a program, these techniques detect errors by focusing on a single program execution. Often a crucial step in these techniques is to define a causal ordering between events in the execution, which is then computed using vector clocks , a simple data structure that stores logical times of threads.

arxiv-2308-12078.title: The 𝐇 \mathbf{H} -flux on flag manifolds generated by infinitesimal 𝐓 \mathbf{T} -duality
arxiv-2308-12078.creator: Elizabeth Gasparim, Lino Grama and Carlos Varea
arxiv-2308-12078.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Elizabeth Gasparim, Lino Grama and Carlos Varea. We define a new correspondence for pairs ( 𝔽 , H ) (\mathbb{F},H) formed by a flag manifold 𝔽 \mathbb{F} together with an H H -flux on 𝔽 \mathbb{F} .

arxiv-2401-12317.title: Software Engineering for Robotics: Future Research Directions Report from the 2023 Workshop on Software Engineering for Robotics
arxiv-2401-12317.creator: Claire Le Goues, Sebastian Elbaum, David Anthony, Celik Berkay, Mauricio Castillo-Effen
arxiv-2401-12317.description: Abstract Executive Summary Robots are experiencing a revolution as they permeate many aspects of our daily lives, from performing house maintenance to infrastructure inspection, from efficiently warehousing goods to autonomous vehicles, and more. This technical progress and its impact are astounding.

arxiv-2412-19680.title: Mixed state entanglement in deformed field theory at finite temperature
arxiv-2412-19680.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . We study mixed state entanglement measures in a higher dimensional T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} deformed field theory at finite temperature. The holographic dual is described by AdS d+1 black brane geometry with a finite cutoff. We compute the entanglement wedge cross section (EWCS), proposed to be dual to entanglement of purification (EoP) and holographic entanglement negativity (HEN) for strip like subsystems. The behavior of EWCS and HEN is studied across different regimes of temperature and deformation parameter.

arxiv-2501-04557.title: Satellite-Terrestrial Routing or Inter-Satellite Routing? A Stochastic Geometry Perspective Thanks: Ruibo Wang and Mohamed-Slim Alouini are with King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), CEMSE division, Thuwal 23955-6900, Saudi Arabia. Mustafa A. Kishk is with the Department of Ele
arxiv-2501-04557.creator: Ruibo Wang, Member, IEEE, Mustafa A. Kishk, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2501-04557.description: Abstract The design and comparison of satellite-terrestrial routing (STR) and inter-satellite routing (ISR) in low Earth orbit satellite constellations is a widely discussed topic. The signal propagation distance under STR is generally longer than that under ISR, resulting in greater path loss. The global deployment of gateways introduces additional costs for STR.

arxiv-2503-13797.title: Adinkras & Genomics in Sixteen Color Systems (I)
arxiv-2503-13797.creator: Jeth Arunseangroj
arxiv-2503-13797.description: Abstract PACS: 11.30.Pb, 12.60.Jv Keywords: supersymmetry, supergravity, superfields, off-shell 1 Introduction In this work, we investigate the proposition that the off-shell problem for the 4D, N=4 Maxwell supermultiplet offers a direction for probing made tractable with non-conventional new mathematical and computational tools.

arxiv-2505-08935.title: On the p p -adic valuations of values of Legendre polynomials
arxiv-2505-08935.creator: Max A. Alekseyev, Tewodros Amdeberhan, Jeffrey Shallit *, Ingrid Vukusic *
arxiv-2505-08935.description: Abstract We prove an explicit formula for the p p -adic valuation of the Legendre polynomials P n ​ ( x ) P_{n}(x) evaluated at a prime p p , and generalize an old conjecture of the third author. We also solve a problem proposed by Cigler in 2017. Research of the last two authors supported by NSERC grant 2024-03725.

pmc-10521564.title: Revolutionising dental technologies: a qualitative study on dental technicians’ perceptions of Artificial intelligence integration
pmc-10521564.creator: Galvin Sim Siang Lin, Yook Shiang Ng, Nik Rozainah Nik Abdul Ghani, Kah Hoay Chua
pmc-10521564.description: BackgroundThe integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in dentistry has the potential to revolutionise the field of dental technologies. However, dental technicians’ views on the use of AI in dental technology are still sparse in the literature. This qualitative study aimed to explore the perceptions of dental technicians regarding the use of AI in their dental laboratory practice.

pmc-10627152.title: Development and performance assessment of a new opensource Bayesian inference R platform for building energy model calibration
pmc-10627152.creator: Danlin Hou, Dongxue Zhan, Liangzhu Wang, Ibrahim Galal Hassan, Nurettin Sezer
pmc-10627152.description: Many factors contribute to the inherent uncertainty of energy consumption modeling in buildings. It is essential to perform a calibration and sensitivity analysis in order to manage these uncertainties. Despite the availability of several calibration methods, they are often deterministic and lack quantified uncertainties. Moreover, the selection of parameters in building energy modeling for calibration depends on the user’s experience.

pmc-10741494.title: TRPV6 Channel Is Involved in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Aggressiveness and Resistance to Chemotherapeutics
pmc-10741494.creator: Gonçalo Mesquita, Aurélien Haustrate, Adriana Mihalache, Benjamin Soret, Clément Cordier, Emilie Desruelles, Erika Duval, Zoltan Pethö, Natalia Prevarskaya, Albrecht Schwab, V’yacheslav Lehen’kyi
pmc-10741494.description: Simple SummaryPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly aggressive cancer with limited treatments and poor prognosis. TRPV6, a calcium-permeable channel overexpressed in cancers, holds potential as an influencer of cancer cell behavior. This study investigates TRPV6 expression in PDAC, analyzing 46 patient tissue samples of varying stages and grades.

pmc-11471909.title: Oral Health Educational Intervention for Primary Healthcare Providers Using the Flipped Approach
pmc-11471909.creator: Maedeh Bonabi, Simin Z Mohebbi, Reza Yazdani, Sepide Rabiei, Jorma Virtanen
pmc-11471909.description: Objectives: This study evaluated the effect of a flipped oral health educational program for primary healthcare providers (PHCPs) on their knowledge, attitude, and practice. Materials and Methods: This field trial was conducted on PHCPs (N=118; 61 cases and 57 controls) in District Health Centers (DHCs) of Tehran, Iran in 2012.

pmc-12745225.title: Continuous visual stimulus tracking to quantify eye motility in spinocerebellar ataxia type 3
pmc-12745225.creator: M. J. de Boer, R. A. Wasmann, J. W. R. Pott, F. W. Cornelissen, N. M. Jansonius
pmc-12745225.description: IntroductionSpinocerebellar ataxias (SCA) form a group of dominantly inherited neurodegenerative diseases represented by progressive cerebellar ataxia and various other neurological deficits. SCA3 is the most prevalent type globally and represents 28% of the autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxias in The Netherlands. The associated oculomotor disorders, with distance esotropia as its hallmark, cause diplopia and often present early.

pmc-12750814.title: Prevalence and patterns of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) among diabetic patients presenting to hospitals in northern state, Sudan: a cross-sectional study during the 2025 humanitarian crisis
pmc-12750814.creator: Ali Abdelhaleem Omar Ahmed, Moaz Alfadil Ahmed Mounfali, Tagwa Yassin, Huzaifa Ibrahim, Reem Abdelhaleem Omar Ahmed, Rana Abdelhaleem Omar Ahmed, Nafisa Ahmed, Omer Abdalhaleem Omer Ahmed, Roaa Mohamed Ali Elbashir, Khalid H Mohamed, Ahmed Manufali
pmc-12750814.description: BackgroundDiabetic ketoacidosis is a major complication of diabetes, with the prevalence ranging from 4.8 to 30% globally for type 1 diabetes and from 1 to 10% for type 2 diabetes. The humanitarian crisis increases DKA risk due to the collapse of support systems.

pmc-12814598.title: Association between high carbohydrate to dietary fiber ratio and risk of dementia in older adults: analysis from the UK biobank
pmc-12814598.creator: Eunji Lee, Jiyun Hwang, Dong Woo Kim, Byung Yoon Choi, Hee-Joon Bae, Seung Hyun Won, Young Ho Park, SangYun Kim
pmc-12814598.description: BackgroundThe dietary carbohydrate-to-fiber ratio (CFR) provides a comprehensive measure of carbohydrate quality; however, its association with cognitive outcomes remains unexplored. Given the distinct health effects of different types of carbohydrates, understanding the impact of CFR on dementia risk and brain structure is valuable.

pmc-12826858.title: Benefits and outcomes of implementing virtual health clinics in remote and underserved areas: a scoping review
pmc-12826858.creator: Mahdieh Poudineh Moghadam, Aliyeh Bazi, Parvaneh Esfahani, Vahideh Emadi
pmc-12826858.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesAccess to quality healthcare is often limited in rural and underserved areas, leading to higher rates of preventable diseases, avoidable hospitalizations, and mortality. Virtual health clinics, utilizing telehealth and telemedicine technologies, offer a promising solution to bridge these gaps. This scoping review aimed to systematically identify and analyze the benefits, outcomes, and service range of virtual clinics in remote and underserved settings.MethodsThis scoping review was conducted following Arksey and O’Malley’s six-stage framework.

pmc-13341347.title: Comparative Effects of Emerging Lp(a)‐Lowering Agents and PCSK9‐Directed Therapies on Lipoprotein(a): A Network Meta‐Analysis of Randomised Clinical Trials
pmc-13341347.creator: Jihad Abu Zayed, Nada A Al‐Awamleh, Mahmoud Hamad, Mohammad Ibrahim Mahmoud Hdaib, Hazem Ayesh
pmc-13341347.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsElevated lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is a genetic ASCVD risk factor that often persists despite intensive LDL‐C lowering. We compared the efficacy and safety of emerging Lp(a)‐targeted therapies (siRNAs, antisense oligonucleotides and an oral assembly inhibitor) with PCSK9‐directed therapies.Materials and MethodsWe searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science and Cochrane CENTRAL through December 6, 2025, for randomised trials in adults (≥ 18 years) with ≥ 8‐week follow‐up reporting Lp(a).

uslaw-usc-t50-s2465.title: 50 U.S.C. § 2465 — Enhancing private-sector employment through cooperative research and development activities
uslaw-usc-t50-s2465.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s2465.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 41 (National Nuclear Security Administration); Subchapter V (Miscellaneous Provisions). (a) In general The Administrator for Nuclear Security shall encourage cooperative research and development activities at the national security laboratories (as defined in section 2471 of this title) that lead to the creation of new private-sector employment opportunities.
